method: Pinned release JS builds in separate targets. Deep samples time 16 searches across four process pairs with nine samples each. Ordinary samples time 500 calls with three process pairs and nine samples each. CLI samples retain nine pairs and include startup, I/O and peak RSS. Reverse runs change initial order. Controls compare the same baseline binary.

probes.method: Counts cover warmups and any budget checks, including allocations in the generated ScheduledTask constructor. Phase timers include probe overhead. A missing candidate allocation timer is stored as zero.
